intro: The Guarded Thunderbrew Barrel rests in the cellar of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. It represents the prized stock of the famed dwarven brewing family, watched over day and night to keep thieves and rivals from meddling with their craft.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This barrel of ale is guarded by Jarven Thunderbrew. As long as he's in the basement, no barrels may be disturbed.
